stackfacts/keywords: call before installing a package an LLM suggested

description: Call before installing a package an LLM suggested: one npm, PyPI or purl version against OSV, CISA KEV and EOL data. Returns ok, warn or block with reasons.

ecosystem.description: npm, pypi, golang, cargo or maven (with name and version, instead of package)

name.description: Package name as the registry spells it, e.g. lodash, @babel/traverse, jinja2, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core

package.description: Package URL with a version, e.g. pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20 or pkg:pypi/jinja2@2.11.2. Types: npm, pypi, golang, cargo, maven (nuget, gem and composer are refused until imported). Send this, or ecosystem, name and version
